en.headline: BigBang opens 20th-anniversary Cosmos tour at Kai Tak Stadium today
en.dek: The K-pop group performs the first of four shows at Kai Tak Stadium from 7 pm, with security checks opening from 11 am and merchandise available to ticket holders.
body: BigBang begins its Hong Kong stop of the 2026-2027 World Tour XX: Cosmos today at Kai Tak Stadium, the first of four performances marking the group's 20th anniversary.

The show starts at 7 pm. Security screening opens from 11 am, with VIP entry from 4.45 pm and general admission from 5 pm, according to venue and organiser information. Merchandise sales for ticket holders open from 11 am at the East Pavilion and close at 6.30 pm.

Further shows are scheduled for 14 and 15 November at 6 pm and an added date on 17 November at 7 pm. Organisers have advised fans to use MTR Kai Tak or Sung Wong Toi stations and public buses, with limited parking available only to holders of valid permits from 11 am.
City-wide photo spots and a commemorative space at The Peak Galleria have been open since earlier in the week as part of the anniversary activations surrounding the concerts.

zh.headline: BigBang今日啟德主場館展開20周年Cosmos巡迴
zh.dek: 組合於晚上7時舉行四場中的首場演出，安檢站上午11時開放，周邊商品僅限當日門票持有人購買。
body: BigBang今日在啟德主場館展開2026-2027年《XX: Cosmos》世界巡迴香港站，為慶祝出道20周年的四場演出中的第一場。
演出於晚上7時開始。主辦單位資料顯示，安檢站由上午11時開放，VIP入場由下午4時45分起，一般觀眾由下午5時起入場。周邊商品售賣處設於東營，上午11時開放，僅限持有當日門票觀眾購買，下午6時30分關閉。
其餘場次分別為11月14日及15日晚上6時，以及加開的11月17日晚上7時。主辦單位建議觀眾使用港鐵啟德站或宋皇臺站及公共交通前往，有限泊車位只開放給持有當日有效泊車證人士，由上午11時起。
配合演唱會的20周年紀念空間及全城打卡點自上週起已陸續開放，包括山頂廣場的限定裝置。
